North Strip.name: The STRAT
North Strip.line: The tower at the top of the Strip, just inside the city line at Sahara.
known: The observation deck and the rides on top, at 1,149 feet
Wedding chapel row, north up the Boulevard

North Strip.name: Sahara
North Strip.line: The 1952 hotel at the corner of Sahara Avenue, where the Monorail ends.
known: The festival grounds across the Boulevard

North Strip.name: Fontainebleau
North Strip.line: The blue tower that stood unfinished for years, open since December 2023.
known: The tallest occupied building in Nevada

North Strip.name: Circus Circus
North Strip.line: The pink big top from 1968, with circus acts over the casino floor.
known: Lucky the Clown, the neon sign

North Strip.name: Resorts World
North Strip.line: Three hotels behind one red tower, on the site of the Stardust.
known: The LED screen that covers the tower

North Strip.name: Peppermill & West Hall
North Strip.line: A 24-hour diner with a fire-pit lounge, beside the newest convention hall.
known: Las Vegas Convention Center West Hall

Wynn & Venetian.name: Wynn & Encore
Wynn & Venetian.line: Two curved bronze towers and a golf course, where the Desert Inn stood.

Wynn & Venetian.name: Fashion Show
Wynn & Venetian.line: The Strip’s big mall, under a steel cloud that hangs over the sidewalk.
known: Trump International’s gold tower behind it

Wynn & Venetian.name: Treasure Island
Wynn & Venetian.line: Pirate ships in a lagoon out front, from the family-friendly 1990s.
known: The footbridges at Spring Mountain Road

Wynn & Venetian.name: Venetian & Palazzo
Wynn & Venetian.line: Canals with gondolas on the second floor, under a painted sky.
known: The Campanile and Rialto Bridge out front

Wynn & Venetian.name: Hard Rock
Wynn & Venetian.line: The Mirage closed in 2024; a guitar-shaped hotel tower is rising where its volcano erupted.
known: Mirage, 1989: the first of the megaresorts

Wynn & Venetian.name: Sphere
Wynn & Venetian.line: The 366-foot ball behind the Venetian, a screen inside and out.
known: The footbridge from the Venetian Expo

Center Strip.name: Harrah’s
Center Strip.line: A mid-priced old hand, with a tiny cheap casino next door.

Center Strip.name: The LINQ
Center Strip.line: An alley of bars and shops that leads from the Boulevard to the wheel.

Center Strip.name: Flamingo
Center Strip.line: Bugsy Siegel’s resort, with real flamingos in the garden and the Cromwell on the corner.
known: The Cromwell and Drai’s on its roof

Center Strip.name: Caesars Palace
Center Strip.line: Roman columns, fountains and statues since 1966, and a mall with a painted sky.
known: The fountains Evel Knievel tried to jump

Center Strip.name: Horseshoe
Center Strip.line: The old Bally’s on the Flamingo corner, now home of the World Series of Poker.
known: The Grand Bazaar Shops out front

Center Strip.name: Bellagio
Center Strip.line: The lake with the dancing fountains, and a glass-flower ceiling in the lobby.
known: Chihuly’s glass flowers over the lobby

Center Strip.name: Paris
Center Strip.line: A half-size Eiffel Tower with its legs through the casino roof.
known: The Arc de Triomphe out front

Center Strip.name: Planet Hollywood
Center Strip.line: The old Aladdin, wrapped in a mall that curves round the whole block.

Center Strip.name: The Cosmopolitan
Center Strip.line: Two glass towers squeezed beside the Bellagio lake, with balconies over the fountains.
known: The Chandelier bar, three storeys of crystal

CityCenter & MGM.name: Aria
CityCenter & MGM.line: The curved glass heart of CityCenter, set back from the Boulevard.
known: The public art collection, Maya Lin and Henry Moore
The free tram to Bellagio and Park MGM

CityCenter & MGM.name: Crystals
CityCenter & MGM.line: A jagged steel-roofed luxury mall, with the Waldorf Astoria next door.

CityCenter & MGM.name: Showcase Mall
CityCenter & MGM.line: Four floors of candy and a giant Coke bottle, on the east side of the Boulevard.

CityCenter & MGM.name: Park MGM
CityCenter & MGM.line: The old Monte Carlo, with an arena and a tree-lined plaza behind it.
known: T-Mobile Arena, home of the Golden Knights

CityCenter & MGM.name: New York-New York
CityCenter & MGM.line: A skyline of twelve towers, with a roller coaster looped around them.
known: The Statue of Liberty and the Brooklyn Bridge

CityCenter & MGM.name: MGM Grand
CityCenter & MGM.line: The green giant on the Tropicana corner, with more than 5,000 rooms.
known: The bronze lion on the corner
The south end of the Monorail

South Strip.name: Excalibur
South Strip.line: A red-and-blue turreted castle from 1990, still the cheap bed on the corner.
known: The free tram to Luxor and Mandalay Bay

South Strip.name: Tropicana Corner
South Strip.line: Where the Tropicana stood from 1957 until its 2024 implosion; the Athletics’ ballpark is going up.
known: The footbridges over the busiest corner on the Strip
Oyo, the old Hooters, behind it

South Strip.name: Luxor
South Strip.line: A black glass pyramid with a sphinx at the door and a light beam from its tip.

South Strip.name: Mandalay Bay
South Strip.line: The gold tower at the south end, with a beach, an aquarium and a convention centre.
known: Mandalay Bay Beach and its wave pool

South Strip.name: Welcome Sign
South Strip.line: The 1959 sign in the median, where the Boulevard leaves the resorts behind.
known: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas sign
